name: Last Seen
author: Mohamed El Meliani
description: All your WhatsApp accounts in the Omarchy bar, one click apart, through your own Evolution API server: read, reply, react, voice notes, media and notifications. Very lightweight (~35 MB per account).

barWidget.description: Read and answer all your WhatsApp accounts from the bar (needs Evolution API).

schema.label: Accounts: Evolution instance names, comma-separated ("demo" shows fake chats)
Your country calling code, so local numbers like 06… work in search (e.g. 33, 212)
RabbitMQ exchange of Evolution (RABBITMQ_EXCHANGE_NAME), if not "evolution"
Also notify group messages (mentions always notify)
Save photos, voice notes and files as they arrive (kept after the sender deletes them)
Appear online while a chat is open (shows others' online / typing… in return)
